item.neoecoprototype.simplify_structure_:
Use it on a multi-block host that is already formed.
[Shift + right-click]
Not built out: builds the shape all the way to its maximum length in one go.
Already built out: carry the L9 parts and the host becomes an L9 machine on the spot - our own L1 and eco's L4/L6 alike.
[What is swapped]
The blocks taken out go back into your inventory; the new parts are taken from it.
[Protection when parts are missing]
When you cannot pay, not one block is taken apart.
It spends 1 paper and 1 blank pattern, and adds a made-up crafting pattern for the work order at hand.
(Note: the parts you already have go in, one work order comes out)

gui.neoecoprototype.dissociator_catalyst: Catalyst: a permanent bonus part, never consumed
Pick an online network device and shift-right-click it to bind it to this card; shift-right-click a second device and the two are joined by a link that crosses no cable and costs no blocks. The mark survives a join, so one tap on a hub and then one tap per spoke is enough. Sneak-right-click in mid-air prints the marked device's two channel numbers - what AE2 gives it and what is already allocated; a plain right-click in mid-air drops the mark - this card joins links and no longer takes them off, that is the L1 Device Unlink Card's job. Shift-right-click an AE2 controller to lift that network one channel step (8 channels per face, then 16, 24, 32). A link is not free: each one draws AE from the network it sits on every tick - the shipped default is 0.5 AE/t and this world's config owns that number, along with how many links one device may carry, how far a link may reach, and whether it may cross dimensions. A link only ever carries the channels AE2 assigns the two devices at its ends; it lays no cable for you.

The device panel cannot tell you whether a link is up: a device whose own grid still has power looks alive even after its link is gone. The card's two channel numbers are the only source: when a link goes, the channels allocated to this device drop with it.
Wireless ME links are switched off in the config of this world (wireless_links), so using this card does nothing right now.

item.neoecoprototype.wireless_unlink_car: Sneak-right-click a network device and every wireless link it carries comes off at once. This card marks nothing and holds no state: whichever device you click is whichever device it clears, so picking the wrong card can no longer dismantle a hub. Links never belonged to a card anyway - they live in the world's data, and a card is only the hand.

item.neoecoprototype.migration_drive.des:
Use on a formed multiblock host that already spans its full length.
[Shift + right click]
Takes it up one rung as asked, on all three families. Every block the swap replaces goes back into your inventory, and what is mounted stays where it was - a storage matrix in its drive, the patterns in their buses.
[This drive is the price]
It is a consumable.
[What is cleared]
The communication interface's information is lost.
